corpusDescription: Post-decision integration replay:prior200 automatic-selection cases (the original198 compression inputs plus two timing boundaries) and the fresh27 validation cases. All prior cohorts are diagnostic in this research pass. Verify exact schema/UTF-16 round trips, exact27 frozen-candidate wires, and legacy-auto full-link fallback; do not use this replay to retune the frozen model. Source snapshot contains the integrated g3 decoder alongside frozen legacy/g2 decoders and transport-pruning optimization. Timing overlaps root validation and is not performance evidence.
measurement: Every character in the complete URL-serialized Markdown link is counted. Only exact normalized-envelope round trips count as successful. codec is transport metadata; all other schema fields and UTF-16 code units are compared.

variants.label: integrated-g3
variants.wasmLoading: The unchanged brotli-wasm ESM/browser binary is read locally through a file: fetch adapter. No native-zlib substitute.
variants.framing: [View](https://agent-render.com/#...); real URL serialization and production Markdown formatter
variants.timing: One ordered pass including cold first-sample costs; indicative CPU timings, not a statistically repeated latency benchmark.

integrationReadback.provenance: Old cohorts are diagnostic in this pass. Previous-g2 values for those cohorts come from their original measured source snapshots, whose wires were replayed exactly before this pass; the fresh reserved baseline is exact commit 5d82b9f.
